source: Owner direct chat following layered-column destruction discussion
owner_instruction_english_translation: No, these columns must not collapse. They should be like the large demonstration column with reinforcement inside. Preferably put reinforcement inside too, either reuse it from the example or make your own, provided it is realistic. Do this; choose executor reasoning at your discretion. Do not run slowdown tests. I will do most testing myself.
authorized_work: Implement a noncollapsing destructible existing lobby column using Next Gen Destruction practices and the large reinforced demo pillar as the named behavior/reference. Author the necessary tile/concrete fracture and internal reinforcement geometry while retaining the existing intact architecture and materials. Default first delivery is one representative column's reachable region; controller asked whether owner wants all columns and proceeds with one unless clarified.
design: Concrete and cladding may chip and detach, including locally bonded composite fragments where feasible, but the column must never sever, topple or collapse. Internal reinforcement must be plausibly dimensioned and placed, using vendor rebar or a purpose-built cage. This explicitly authorizes the bounded existing-column destruction conversion; it does not reopen general lobby architectural redesign.
execution: One Multica production worker. Controller selects Astra/max/default speed. User permits task-local executor reasoning discretion; choosing max retains the existing verified profile. Preserve original source assets and unrelated owner edits, snapshot current map before modification, and commit verified task-scoped delivery locally.
verification: No slowdown tests. Owner performs principal play/design testing. Executor may perform build/asset checks and a small normal-speed smoke test for firing, localized destruction, no collapse and reset. One focused independent technical/visual evidence review remains required; the owner has not waived it. Do not expand into a full gameplay/performance test matrix.
boundaries: Do not reopen MSQ-150/151, revive retired custom ED implementation, modify vendor originals, alter unrelated lobby actors or create a new laboratory. Owner visual/play acceptance remains separate. Preserve Config/DefaultEngine.ini, MeridianSquad.uproject and untracked Docs/EnvironmentDestruction01ED02.md changes.
